notes: QSC official AD-C820 product page. Passive 2-way: 8 in ferrite woofer + 1.4 in neodymium compression driver; sensitivity 91 dB SPL, 1 W/1 m; nominal impedance 16 ohm (bypass; 70 V/100 V transformer taps also published); continuous power handling 200 W (IEC, 50 Hz-20 kHz, 6 dB crest), recommended amplifier power 400 W program; frequency response 61 Hz-18 kHz at -6 dB (52 Hz-18 kHz usable at -10 dB), measured half-space (2 pi); 90 deg conical coverage; ported; 18 L back box AD-C800BB; 7.9 kg system.
